note: R5 evolution-test redesign (13.11/13.12/13.13/13.15): the original tests byte-reproduced gold's specific coarse-grid ICN run (np.allclose 1e-8) on UNPHYSICAL inputs -> over-specified (a correct solver using any other stable 2nd-order scheme fails). Redesign per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-24-p13-evolution-test-redesign-design.md: physically-meaningful divergence-free inputs (toroidal magnetic-dipole, sigma=(-1,-1,1)) + a CONVERGED reference (RK4@ref_courant, correct parities incl. the R4 A_z fix) + a TIGHT atol == the algorithm's own 2nd-order convergence error (test_courant small; stepper spec lands EXACTLY at t_const). config2 adds A_z=c*xyz*e^-r^2 to excite E_z so the z-parity is testable (config1 is z-blind). 13.12 decoupled from the stepper (direct-set E, deterministic ‖div E‖). Targets generated by scicode_verified/refs/p13_ref.py via build transform _type=maxwell_evolution_ref.

13.9.fix: A_z inner-boundary symmetry parity (1,1,-1) -> (-1,-1,-1). The gold value is vector-inconsistent: gold's own A_x=(1,-1,1),A_y=(-1,1,1) imply the z-axis magnetic-dipole config sigma=(-1,-1,1), which forces A_z=(-1,-1,-1), and that equals gold's own E_z parity (E and A share symmetry per the Lorenz-gauge prompt). gold's A_z=(1,1,-1) is the lone violator. See ledger/BUG_13_Az_symmetry.md.
13.9.verify: our independent _p13 operators in gold's convention reproduce the prior gold 13.9 target to 1e-12 on ALL 7 comps with the BUGGY A_z; with corrected A_z, comps E_x,E_y,E_z,A_x,A_y,phi stay <1e-9 vs prior gold, only A_z (comp 5) changes (~3.92). Build asserts this self-check.

13.10.fix: 13.10 target = update_fields(fields, derivatives(...)). Its gold target inherited 13.9's A_z bug verbatim (A_z_new = A_z + factor*dt*A_z_dot, with the buggy A_z_dot). Regenerated with the corrected derivatives. Pure propagation: target A_z error = factor*dt*3.918 per test (0.196/0.118/0.078).
13.10.verify: our reference reproduces prior gold 13.10 to 1e-14 on ALL 7 comps with the BUGGY A_z; with the fix only A_z (comp 5) changes. update_fields is the trivial linear update (carries no parity). Build asserts this self-check.

13.11.fix: stepper redesign. target = final 7-field state after evolving each physical config to t_stepper with the CONVERGED reference (RK4@ref_courant). test compares model stepper output (courant=test_courant, lands exactly at t_const) within atol == 2nd-order convergence floor. config1 (toroidal dipole) checks x-y evolution; config2 (+A_z excitation) checks z/E_z evolution & the A_z/E_z parity.
13.11.verify: build self-check: config1 E_z (comp 2) ~ 0 (z-blind); config2 develops |E_z| > 0.1 (z-excited, non-vacuous). all finite.

13.12.fix: check_constraint decoupled from the (over-specified) stepper. Original target = the ICN 2nd-intermediate value left as the constraint on maxwell (a stepper-internal artifact). Redesign: directly set E and compare the deterministic ‖div E‖ (sqrt(sum(div^2)*delta^3), exactly the docstring's definition). dipole=config1 div-free E (small constraint); linear=E=(x,y,z) -> analytic div=3 (large constraint). Deterministic operator -> exact match (atol=1e-9).
13.12.verify: build self-check: dipole constraint < linear constraint; both finite; linear ~ matches analytic div=3 scale.

13.13.fix: integrate redesign. target = final 7-field state after integrating each physical config to t_max (chunked by t_check, CONVERGED reference). test compares model integrate's in-place final field within atol AND asserts the returned constraint series is finite & bounded. config2 covers E_z/A_z (parity). (Original target = constraint series byte-reproducing gold ICN -> over-specified.)
13.13.verify: build self-check: config1 E_z ~ 0; config2 |E_z| > 0.1; all finite.

13.15.fix: main redesign. target = constraint time-series from main on config1 (dipole) at the test grid. main returns ONLY the series (no field access), so the test compares the series within atol_series (the constraint operator amplifies field error ~1/delta, so its own tight tolerance). z-coverage is via 13.11/13.13 config2, so main stays config1. function_header docstring also corrected: returns an ndarray series (gold returns a flat array), not the 'list of tuples' the original docstring wrongly claimed.
13.15.verify: build self-check: 1-D series of length t_max/t_check (=5), finite, positive.
